arrival.text: Bellwether Field Office. The Harrows are clear. Find what stayed behind. Call when you need me.

kit.text: Check your instruments. Read the family notes. Find a hiding place before you need one.

hint_signal.text: Start with the rooms they used most. Follow the meter. An echo is not always the source.

hint_trace.text: Look at what the family left behind. Ultraviolet may show you what they could not see.

hint_voice.text: The recorder needs a quiet room. Ask once, then listen.

warning.text: That is not interference. Find cover. Light off. Stay quiet.

return.text: I can hear the rain again. Come back to the van.

ending.text: The line is clear. You did it. We are going home.

evp.text: Her chair. Do not put it away. Keep the house warm.

contain.text: Keep it quiet. Let the last note end.

cc_bargain.text: I asked for a night that would never end. Something under the stones said yes.

cc_night.text: Dawn is only a rumour here. The moons keep the hours now.

cc_steward.text: The steward hid them. Faithful fool. He thought I would not remember.

cc_relic_blade.text: Silver, cold in the dark. Where the dead keep what they cannot spend.

cc_relic_hilt.text: A hilt held up to the stars. The wanderer's socket sits empty, waiting.

cc_relic_moon.text: A moon behind a painted face. Some doors are only faces.

cc_listen.text: I can hear your heart. It is very loud in my house.

cc_stay.text: Stay. Everyone stays. The drawbridge is only a memory of leaving.

cc_ledger_steward.text: Eleventh night, and no dawn. I have hidden the silver blade among the dead beneath the chapel, in a box that opens only to the marks of his claws. He will not look where he sleeps in blood.

cc_ledger_orrery.text: Thirteenth night. The Count's orrery carries a planet that does not exist, and its socket stands empty. I set the hallowed hilt there, where the brass wanders and the third moon should be.

cc_ledger_portrait.text: Fifteenth night. The portraits watch me write. One of them is a door. Behind its face I have set the moonstone. If I do not return, forge all three at the chapel altar.

cc_hunt_smell.text: I can smell the lamp oil.

cc_hunt_run.text: Run. The hall is very long.

cc_hunt_hungry.text: Come out. I am so very hungry.

cc_kit.text: Take them. The steward took them too. They did not help him.

cc_ending.text: Dawn. I had forgotten its colour. Go, and leave the door open.
